$comment: Troop types and tiers. Tiers 1–10 come from upgrading the matching camp; the top tiers are unlocked by War Academy research instead, and not every state has them yet — delete the ones yours cannot train. Per-troop costs ship empty; fill in the tiers you are working on, or use a Custom step on the Growth Plan.
fireCrystalNote: Once the state reaches the Age of Fire Crystal and the camp passes level 30, troops become Fire Crystal versions of the same tier — a T9 becomes an FC T9, with better base stats. Two Fire Crystal skills unlock along the way, around FC3 and FC8.

types.role: Counters marksmen and breaks through the enemy front.

types.name: Marksman
types.role: Damage from the back line — the reason rallies hit hard.
